data.description: Fairway Villas 2 at Emaar South: Luxurious Living Amidst Nature and Golf

data.answer:
This upcoming project in Dubai lies at the heart of Emaar South. Ideally situated near Al Maktoum International Airport, this exclusive off-plan villa community offers unparalleled convenience and connectivity. Residents enjoy refined golf living surrounded by lush green landscapes, blending leisure with luxury. Emaar South provides countless opportunities for growth and fulfillment, all in a setting that perfectly balances modern living with everyday ease. 

At the heart of Fairway Villas 2, you’ll find a future filled with endless possibilities, where a serene lifestyle and world-class amenities converge. With an inspired mix of amenities, recreational spaces, and a thoughtfully designed environment, Fairway Villas 2 Emaar South provides an exceptional lifestyle that celebrates both comfort and connection to nature.

Fairway Villas 2 offer a selection of exquisite 3 and 4-bedroom villas designed in two architectural styles: Astra and Nova. With coverage areas ranging from 2,990 sq. ft. to 3,108 sq. ft., these two-storey villas provide spacious indoor and outdoor spaces to enhance the living experience. 

Each villa boasts expansive bedrooms with attached en-suite bathrooms, built-in wardrobes, fully-fitted kitchens, and powder rooms. Balconies offer sweeping views of the lush surroundings, allowing residents to relax in the beauty of the landscape right from the comfort of home. 

Additional features include a maid’s room, a private parking area, and a beautifully landscaped garden, making Fairway Villas 2 a highly desirable choice for luxurious and comfortable living in Emaar South.

Buying a Property in Fairway Villas 2

Searching for villa projects for sale in Dubai? Villas for sale in Emaar South Dubai offer an exclusive opportunity to own a luxurious residence in one of the city’s premier communities. Purchasing a 3-bedroom villa in Fairway Villas 2 typically ranges from AED 2.8M to AED 3.3M, while 4-bedroom villas are available between AED 4M and AED 4.4M. 

These villas promise valuable returns on investment, making Fairway Villas 2 an attractive option for those seeking a prestigious property within Dubai’s esteemed residential projects.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Fairway Villas 2?

data.answer:
Living in Fairway Villas 2 Dubai offers a blend of luxury and tranquility, with stunning golf course views, lush green spaces, and modern amenities at every turn. Residents enjoy a family-friendly community that prioritizes both relaxation and an active lifestyle.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Fairway Villas 2

Residents relying on public transportation have access to two nearby bus stations. The Dubai World Central, Staff Village bus stop is about a 9-minute drive away, while the Dubai World Central, Freight House 2 bus stop is accessible in approximately 6 minutes. 

The floor plans of homes in Fairway Villas 2 include dedicated parking garages, ensuring residents always have convenient parking options. Additionally, street-side parking is readily available for visitors, as Dubai South’s lower population density makes finding a spot hassle-free. 

Supermarkets in and Around Fairway Villas 2

Fairway Villas 2 offer convenient access to South Village, a community mall catering to Emaar South residents. Spanning approximately 22,000 sq. m., the mall houses a large Geant Express outlet, offering a wide selection of fresh, frozen, and imported food items. 

Additionally, Allday Minimart, a small convenience store, is just a short drive away. For more extensive shopping, residents can visit Grand Hyper Sakany, a hypermarket located nearby, as part of the Sakany Accommodation complex.

Shopping Mall in and Near Fairway Villas 2

Besides an exclusive retail center within the community, Fairway Villas 2 residents have access to two major malls nearby: Ibn Battuta Mall and Marina Mall. The closest option is Ibn Battuta Mall, located just 26 minutes away, offering a unique shopping experience with sections themed around various countries, including China, India, and Spain. 

Schools and Nurseries in and Near Fairway Villas 2

The option in the master community Dubai South is GEMS Founders School, while Greenfield International School in Dubai Investment Park is about 20 minutes away. In the nearby community of Jebel Ali, there is The Winchester School, Jebel Ali School, and Jebel Ali Village Nursery.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Fairway Villas 2

Several mosques are located near Emaar South, with the nearest being the Al Maktoum Airport Mosque at Al Maktoum International Airport. For people of other faiths, the church complex in Jebel Ali is about a 25-minute drive from Fairway Villas 2, providing a convenient option for Christian residents to attend religious services.

Notable churches in the Jebel Ali area include Mor Ignatius Jacobite Syrian Orthodox Cathedral Dubai, Covenant Hope Church, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, and St. Mina Coptic Orthodox Church. Moreover, there is a Hindu Temple and Gurudwara in the area too.

Location & Nearby Areas

Fairway Villas 2 at Emaar South offers excellent connectivity to key areas in Dubai. It’s just a 5-minute drive from Al Maktoum International Airport, making travel highly convenient. The Expo City site is about 15 minutes away, while both Dubai Investments Park and Jebel Ali are reachable in around 20 minutes, providing access to major business and industrial zones.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Fairway Villas 2

data.answer:
Fairway Villas 2 neighborhood highlights include access to lush golf courses and beautifully landscaped parks, perfect for outdoor relaxation and leisure. Residents can also enjoy nearby recreational facilities, ensuring a balanced lifestyle full of activities and community events.

Restaurants Near Fairway Villas 2

The community itself will feature many upscale restaurants in the future. Meanwhile, residents can visit the eateries close by. Ibn Battuta Mall has many popular cafes and restaurants ranging from T.G.I Fridays to Starbucks.

Hotels in and Around Fairway Villas 2

The Fairway Villas 2 community will soon feature a hotel, adding to the area’s convenience. Nearby, Aloft Dubai South is strategically positioned close to Al Maktoum Airport. In addition to an exclusive selection of suites, Aloft offers a fitness center, restaurant, bars, and various recreational spaces for guests.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Residents of Fairway Villas 2 can enjoy ample outdoor activities, from golfing on the championship course to jogging in lush, landscaped parks. The community also offers fitness centers and beauty salons, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle for health and relaxation. The community boasts the following facilities:

  • 18-hole championship golf course
  • Community center
  • District park

Attractions and Landmarks

Fairway Villas 2 at Emaar South offers residents easy access to several key attractions and landmarks that enhance its appeal. Right within the community, you'll find the Emaar South Golf Course, an 18-hole championship course perfect for golf enthusiasts. Just a short 5-minute drive away is Al Maktoum International Airport, providing seamless connectivity for both domestic and international travel.

Additionally, Expo City Dubai, the former site of Expo 2020, is only 15 minutes away, now serving as a vibrant hub for innovation, cultural events, and exhibitions. These nearby landmarks make Fairway Villas 2 an ideal choice for those seeking a balanced lifestyle with convenient access to leisure, travel, and entertainment.

While Fairway Villas 2 offers an exceptional lifestyle with its serene environment and world-class amenities, prospective residents should consider the suburban setting, which is ideal for those seeking tranquility and space.

Is Fairway Villas 2 A Family-Friendly Community?

Yes, Fairway Villas 2 is a family-friendly community, offering spacious homes, lush parks, and proximity to schools, creating an ideal environment for families.

What are the Benefits of Living in Fairway Villas 2, Emaar South?

Benefits of living in Fairway Villas 2 include access to an 18-hole championship golf course, modern amenities, and a serene setting within Emaar South, enhancing quality of life.

What Amenities are Offered in Fairway Villas 2?

Amenities in Fairway Villas 2 encompass a golf course, landscaped parks, swimming pools, children's play areas, fitness centers, and retail outlets, providing a comprehensive lifestyle.

Is Fairway Villas 2 a Good Investment?

Investing in Fairway Villas 2 is advantageous due to its strategic location, high-quality construction by Emaar Properties, and potential for strong rental yields and property appreciation.

At Fairway Villas 2 Emaar South, residents enjoy the elegance of a golf resort, complete with meticulously landscaped greens, scenic views of a linear park, and tree-lined walkways that provide a serene backdrop to this beautiful community.

Situated next to a stunning 18-hole championship golf course, Fairway Villas 2 Emaar South offers a lifestyle that seamlessly blends modern comfort with the peaceful allure of nature. Each villa boasts generous spaces, a contemporary design, and carefully crafted features that enhance the daily living experience.
